fuentes.texto: The solar storms in the game come from DONKI, NASA's space weather database.
The MOXIE instrument on the Perseverance rover made oxygen from the CO₂ on Mars.
The RAD instrument on the Curiosity rover measures radiation at the surface: about 0.7 mSv per day.
Dust covered InSight's panels (2022) and a global storm left Opportunity without power (2018).
The Phoenix lander found water ice under the ground in 2008.
Phoenix also found perchlorates in the Martian soil: toxic salts that would have to be removed from water before drinking it.
Red lettuce, mizuna and radishes have been grown on the ISS. The data from these experiments is in OSDR.
A message between Mars and Earth takes between 3 and 22 minutes to arrive, depending on where the planets are.
Earth and Mars line up well for travel roughly every 26 months.
